## The Optimal Complete Portfolio

Complete Portfolio ($C$) = Risky Portfolio ($P$) + Risk-free Asset ($f$)

Optimal Complete portfolio weights:  $\displaystyle y^* = \frac{E(r_P) - r_f}{A\cdot \sigma_P^2}$, where $A$ is the risk aversion coefficient.

Return of the Complete Portfolio: 
$$
\begin{aligned}
E(r_C) &= yE(r_P) + (1-y) r_f \\
&= r_f + y \left[E(r_P)-r_f\right]
\end{aligned}
$$

Variance of the Complete Portfolio:  $\sigma^2_C = y^2\cdot \sigma_P^2.$
